completion_data.completion_summary: Settled that the task frame's fourth constraint need not be directed: over any history with countably many times -- hence over both instantiated carriers, Z-time and Q-time -- the standard nest condition S1 buys exactly what the directed S1d buys at lem:step, so the directedness is kept on the naturalness criterion rather than extracted from a theorem. No candidate better than Saturation was found: Completion loses because its hypothesis clause is def:world-history's clause verbatim and it is provably equivalent to the success of the construction its own theorem performs, and the fibers-only weakening loses because segments are load bearing. Saturation is therefore kept as def:frame's constraint with Completion demoted to the derived condition, and the extension chain's prose, the theorem index and four module READMEs were reversed to match.
